# Claims shown in context

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet, and a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere; some worlds glue nowhere (Specker's boxes; the two-qubit Mermin–Peres square). Parts fail a whole in two ways: they do not give it back, or there is none.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Claims shown in contexts (Contextual S K C V): within k c says that claim c lies within context k, and shows s k c is what k shows of c at configuration s. At s what the contexts show glues (Contextual.Glues) when some v : C → V agrees with every context on every claim within it; this gives that any two contexts a claim lies within agree (Contextual.Glues.agree), and where each claim lies within some context the two are equivalent (Contextual.glues_iff_agree). Read with its context, everything shown is a claim of a frame (Contextual.indexed), and the indexed frame fits everything shown (Contextual.indexed_fits); a frame of context-free claims fits (Contextual.FitsFree) exactly where what the contexts show glues at every configuration (Contextual.fitsFree_iff). Where what a context can show depends only on the claims within it (Local) and no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities (NoGlobal), no configuration respecting the possibilities glues (Contextual.not_glues), and if one configuration respects them no frame of context-free claims fits (Contextual.no_free_frame). What a whole W allows within a context (restrict) is local (restrict_local), and W lies within what its parts glue to (Glued, glued_of_whole); the parts giving the whole back is PartsDetermine; nonempty possibilities with no context-free reading are the parts of no whole (no_whole). Specker's three boxes and three openings, exactly one of the two opened holding the gem: the possibilities are local (Specker.local_), no opening forces a box (Specker.unforced), no placement fits all (Specker.noGlobal), the world showing the gem in each opening's first box respects them (Specker.respects) and does not glue (Specker.not_glues), and they are the parts of no whole (Specker.no_whole). The Mermin–Peres square, nine cells in three rows and three columns, rows and the first two columns of even parity and the third column odd: the possibilities are local (Square.local_), no line forces a cell (Square.unforced), no assignment fits all six lines (Square.nine, Square.noGlobal), and they are the parts of no whole (Square.no_whole). The quantum realization (Becoming.Quantum): the nine two-qubit observables as integer matrices each square to I (obs_sq), the three of each line commute pairwise (line_commute), and a line multiplies to −I in the third column and to I otherwise (line_product); the values a nonzero vector shows jointly on a line have the line's parity (line_parity) and are a possibility of the line (shows_support), and every possibility is shown by an explicit integer vector (line_realized, support_shown); so no assignment to the nine cells is shown jointly on every line by quantum states (no_context_free_values). No Lean axiom is used (except by the generated injectivity lemmas injEq, which no source declaration uses).

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise: glues_iff_agree and fitsFree_iff are two-way and need a context each claim lies within (home, covers).
- not_glues and no_free_frame need local possibilities, no context-free reading and one configuration respecting them; no_whole needs some context to allow something, and does not use locality (local conditions).
- The quantum realization covers only this square: real matrices and integer eigenvectors; Hilbert space, measurement and Born weights are not stated.

P72 and P72q (work board), following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026, answering Ren's “wave/particle”: the core's Frame reads claims as context-free by type; here that is named a commitment of the representation, with the condition under which it fits; what quantum measurements show is of the kind that does not glue (Kochen–Specker for two qubits, Mermin 1990, Peres 1990). P72q was written and checked by “Cause–effect system theory comparison” (the owner of P64–P68). The two ways parts fail a whole (not giving it back: P70's parity; having no whole: no_whole) are the uniqueness and gluing conditions of a sheaf, for possibilities. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; Ren agreed with the reply containing them): wave and particle are both projections onto context-free values; a value is what a context shows, a relation; the truth of Ren's speculation is relational. See §96 of the integration note.

- Specker's three boxes and the Mermin–Peres square: consistent within each context, no context forcing a claim, no context-free reading (Specker.noGlobal, Square.noGlobal); qubits realize the square (no_context_free_values of Becoming.Quantum).
